commercial-stainless-steel-filtered-cold.shortDescription: Plumbed-in commercial bubbler in SUS304 stainless steel — 20 L/hr cooling, WaterMark certified.
commercial-stainless-steel-filtered-cold.description:
A high-traffic public-venue bubbler built around a SUS304 stainless steel cabinet and an integrated cooling and filtration unit. Direct mains connection — no bottles to refill, no cartridges to ship.

Designed for **continuous service** in offices, schools, gyms, and hospitality. The integrated drip tray with drainage system keeps the surrounding floor dry through peak hours, and the push-button activation copes with thousands of cycles a year without service.

- Welded stainless steel frame and exterior panels
- Integrated cooling unit, factory-tested for Australian mains pressure
- Standard plumbing connections — any qualified plumber can install or service
features: All SUS304 stainless steel welded frame and exterior panels
Integrated drip tray with drainage system
Direct mains connection — no bottles to refill
Push-button activation rated for high-traffic public use
Standard plumbing inlets — no proprietary fittings

compliance.note: WaterMark certified for plumbed-in installation under AS/NZS 3497.

wm-3-stages-20-x-4-5-triple-big-blue-who.shortDescription: Three-stage 20" × 4.5" Big Blue whole-house filter — sediment, carbon, and polishing in WaterMark-certified housings.
wm-3-stages-20-x-4-5-triple-big-blue-who.description:
A three-stage whole-house filtration system built around 20-inch by 4.5-inch *Big Blue* housings — the de-facto Australian standard for whole-house treatment. Each stage targets a distinct contaminant load: sediment first, then dissolved chlorine and organics through carbon, then a final polish.

Designed for **mains or rainwater feeds** at typical Australian household flow rates. The housings are WaterMark-certified for direct plumbing into a property's main supply, and they accept any 20×4.5 cartridge from any supplier — there is no proprietary lock-in. Replace cartridges yourself or have a plumber service annually.

- Three 20×4.5 Big Blue housings on a single mounting bracket
- WaterMark-certified components for plumbed-in mains use
- Open-standard cartridges — buy replacements from any Australian supplier
features: Single galvanised mounting bracket — wall-mount ready
Stage 1 sediment, Stage 2 carbon, Stage 3 polishing cartridge
Pressure release buttons on each housing for tool-free servicing
recommendedFor: Whole-house treatment of mains or rainwater supply
Properties on tank or bore water
Sites with chlorinated mains where taste and odour matter
Households planning to service cartridges themselves
